title: 21-Year-Old Daughter Acts Like An Entitled Brat After Refusing To Leave Dads House
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 24th, 2023. Police were called to a house in reference to a daughter who refused to leave her dad’s house. The daughter had been evicted and no longer lived there however she kept coming back to cause a disturbance on multiple occasions. She said she had mail that was there however her dad and police said she had no mail there for her because she no longer lived there. She was upset that her dad had divorced her mom and moved on to a different woman and no longer loved her and his original family, she also claimed that he owed her $20,000. Police issued her a trespass warning, and if she returned on the property she would be arrested but she came back and kept acting extremely belligerent and entitled, ultimately leading to her arrest. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
